versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.1 - OTA Update Hardening
- Filesystem updates are now staged in PSRAM and checksum-verified BEFORE any flash is touched: a corrupted or interrupted transfer can no longer destroy the web app
- Combined packages are all-or-nothing: firmware finalization is deferred until the filesystem component verifies too, so a half-failed package leaves the device exactly as it was
- Automatic rollback: if new firmware crash-loops before completing a boot, the device reverts to the previous firmware on its own (verified live with a deliberately crashing build)
- Crash-loop detection made deterministic (removed meaningless cross-reboot timestamp comparisons that could randomly defeat safe boot)
- Update packages are board-tagged: a package built for a different board model is rejected before anything is written
- A client disconnect mid-upload no longer blocks all future update attempts until reboot
- Update failure responses now carry the real reason (e.g. board mismatch) instead of generic library errors
- Fixed a crash (and reboot) when an update was rejected mid-upload
- Fixed pre-OTA settings backup silently failing to save

Version 1.2.0 - First release for the Waveshare ESP32-P4 Nano profile
- First GitHub-published release for this board variant (Combined OTA updates now functional)
- Fixed Combined OTA filesystem updates: partition lookup used the wrong label and would always fail to find the web app partition
- Fixed Combined OTA filesystem erase blocking long enough to trip the task watchdog mid-update, corrupting LittleFS and wiping the web app - erase is now chunked with periodic watchdog resets
- Fixed pre-OTA backup silently failing to write (missing /backups directory)
- Removed channel merge mode (LTP/HTP): simplified to always-overwrite, since this project doesn't have multiple independent sources contending for the same channels
- Generalized P4-specific Ethernet naming (P4_ETH_* / p4-ethernet) to chip-agnostic RMII naming, since the same code already supports both IP101 and KSZ8863 hardware
- Fixed a crash in the Settings Diagnostics panel caused by a warnings API response shape mismatch
- Fixed a full SD card scan needlessly caching unrelated files (e.g. camera photos) on every request, wasting heap
- Fixed a Sensors page crash/freeze (React Query enabled-flag type mismatch) that made navigation unresponsive
- Sensors page: system toggle now defaults off when no sensors are configured
- Dashboard: added a sensor system status badge (Active/Disabled/No Sensors) to the Sensors & Automations card
- Effects page: reworked layout so Power/Brightness aligns with the effects grid and the settings panel uses the full column height
- Reordered Scheduling after Playlists in the navigation menu
